title: Joel Roberts Poinsett to James Monroe, Santiago de Chile, 20 Feb 1813 (NARA M37 roll 2)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59, Despatches from Special Agents vol. 3 = M37 roll 2 (naId 213803757), frames 0092-0094

plaintext.source: No decipherment with the letter; Manning 1925 prints the clear text with '(undeciphered cipher)'.

transcription.source: NARA catalogue JPEGs of M37 roll 2 frames 0093-0094
transcription.notes: P1-P9 transcribed; P0 on frame 0092 (f. 37r) not transcribed, the frame is nearly black.

system.summary: Numbered two-part code of about 1,600 groups: common words as single groups, longer words spelled from syllable groups; a circle over a group adds -s.
system.sibling_key: Poinsett to Monroe, Buenos Aires 14 June 1814 (M37 roll 2 frame 0098, duplicate 0100), same code with a clerk's interlinear decode.
system.notes: Homophones: 'a' is both 1215 and 1315 in the 1814 decode. Cross and caret marks under/over groups not yet explained.

prior_solution.where: Manning 1925 vol. 2 doc. 442 prints the cipher places as '(undeciphered cipher)'; web search found no decipherment.

solution.what: Manning vol. 2 doc. 442 read for the clear context; web search for a decipherment or the 1810 cypher: none found.
Fetched M37 roll 2 frames 0091-0102 from the NARA catalogue; the letter is at 0092-0094.
Transcribed passages P1-P9 (437 groups, 256 distinct) line by line; P0 on frame 0092 illegible after background flattening.
Applied the repo's US code tables (JQA/Department 1803-40, Armstrong THE=972, Pinckney, 1788 legation, Jefferson 1787, Mountflorence 1801) directly: noise.
shift_test.py: every constant shift and mod 1600/1700 of the same tables, scored with lang en-modern 4-gram; best z 4.3 among about 9,000 settings, junk decodes.
Sumter, Rio 1813 (M121 vol. 1A frames 0035-0039, interlinear decode) checked: the = 798, of = 1399; a different code.
Poinsett 14 June 1814 (frame 0098, duplicate 0100) found in the same code with a clerk's interlinear decode; 88 values aligned into key_1814.tsv.
decode.py applied the sibling key to the 1813 groups: 158 of 437 have a value; fragments, no sentence reads yet.

outcome.fraction_read_source: decode_1813.txt, cipher tokens with a value from key_1814.tsv (decode.py)
outcome.notes: In progress: context pass and further key material (Weber 1979, HSP Poinsett Papers) still to do.
